headline: Recommended approval of new speed hump policies, flashing crosswalk beacons, and handicap parking changes; asked for three Clover St. stop signs to be removed.
summary: Most handicap parking requests were recommended for approval, including spaces at 11 Lodi St. and 15 Arline St. Requests for 20 Worth St., 15 and 17 Caroline St., and stop signs at Lake Ave. and Bigelow Davis Pkwy. were held. Several other requests, including winter parking ban changes on Doris St. and Daniels St., were filed.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 28, 2026 meeting, 2-0.
Recommended approval of removing the handicap parking space at 52 Ward St., 2-0.
Recommended approval of one handicap parking space opposite 243 Tacoma St., 2-0.
Recommended approval of a handicap parking space in front of 11 Lodi St., 3-0.
Recommended approval of removing the handicap parking space in front of 1 Kingsbury St., 3-0.
Held the request for a handicap parking space in front of 20 Worth St. for further discussion with the petitioner, 3-0.
Recommended approval of a handicap loading zone in front of 15 Arline St., 3-0.
Recommended approval of removing the handicap parking space in front of 63 Airlie St., 3-0.
Recommended holding the request, as amended, to remove two handicap parking spaces in front of 15 and 17 Caroline St., 3-0.
Recommended approval of flashing beacons at two crosswalks near Winthrop St. and Vernon St., pending funding, 3-0.
Recommended approval of a No Parking Anytime zone across the driveway of 48 Windham St., 3-0.
Recommended approval of No Parking Anytime signage on Wall St. at Thorne St., 3-0.
Recommended approval of increased speed and traffic enforcement on Melrose St., 3-0.

Recommended holding the request, as amended, for a stop sign facing Mohawk Ave. at Clover St., 2-0, and a Chairman's Order asking the City Manager to have three non-ordained stop signs on Clover St. removed.
Recommended filing the request to remove stop signs on Clover St. at Montello St., 2-0.
Recommended filing the request to remove stop signs on Clover St. at Pine View Ave., 2-0.
Recommended holding the request for stop signs on Lake Ave. at Bigelow Davis Pkwy., 2-0, and a Chairman's Order asking for Intersection Ahead signs on Lake Ave.
Recommended adjusting the timing of the traffic signal at Southbridge St. and Hammond St., 2-0.
Recommended filing the request for Turtle Crossing signs on Massasoit Rd., 2-0.
Recommended filing the request for a Yield Blind Driveway sign at 285 Salisbury St., 2-0.
Recommended filing the request for duck crossing signs on Stafford St., 2-0.
Recommended filing the request for more truck wayfinding signs on West Boylston Dr., 2-0.
Recommended approval of Do Not Block Intersection signage on Pleasant St. at Vesper St., 2-0, and a Chairman's Order asking for statutory speed limit signs on Pleasant St.
Recommended approval of One Way and Do Not Enter signs on Fairmont St. at Dartmouth St., 2-0.
Recommended approval of One Way and Do Not Enter signs on Fairmont St. at Clarendon St., 2-0.
Recommended filing the request for a truck ban on Holden St. from Shore Dr. to Grove St., 3-0.
Recommended filing the request to make the winter parking ban on Doris St. a declared ban, 2-0.
Recommended filing the request to make the winter parking ban on Daniels St. a declared ban, 2-0.
Recommended holding the request to change the winter parking ban on Henrietta St., 3-0, for further discussion with DPW.
Recommended filing the informational communication on e-scooter and e-bike regulations, 2-0.
Recommended approval of new policies and procedures for the traffic-calming speed hump program, 2-0.

. Virtual Attendee Call-In Information/Important Notice to Residents 1 
Pursuant to Chapter 20 of the Acts of 2021 and in order to ensure active, public 
engagement, the City of Worcester currently allows for both in -person and remote 
participation at all City Council and Standing Committee meetings. To partake in the 
meeting, you may attend the meeting in -person within the meeting location, follow the 
below link to join via Zoom or dial the direct line as indicated. If you join a Zoom meeting 
by dialing in with a phone number, you can raise your hand by dialing *9.
Traffic and Parking Committee Zoom Link:

a.
Important Notice: Residents are advised of an ongoing scam involving the impersonation 
of city officials and departments. Scammers are fraudulently requesting payments be made 
for planning and zoning permits, as well as City Council petitions. All official emails 
regarding your petition will come exclusively from an @worcesterma.gov email address 
(such as clerk @worcesterma.gov), or via physical mail on the City of Worcester’s official 
letterhead. Any legitimate hearing letter will always include your specific application 
details, along with the scheduled hearing date, time, and location. The City of Worcester 
will never request payments via wire transfer.
